item.title: Kenya’s flower industry loses millions of dollars weekly due to the Iran war
item.summary: Kenya’s flower industry is losing up to $1.4 million a week as the Iran war cuts demand and disrupts shipping

item.title: Iran war deflects attention from Ukraine as Russia starts spring offensive
item.summary: The Iran war has deflected global attention from Russia’s all-out invasion of its neighbor Ukraine as Europe’s biggest conflict since World War II enters its fifth year and an emboldened Kremlin undertakes a spring offensive

item.title: Zimbabwe says 15 of its citizens killed after fraudulent recruitment into Russia-Ukraine war
item.summary: Zimbabwe says fraudulent recruiters have lured its citizens into the Russia-Ukraine war, and some have died

item.title: Russia says it shot down almost 400 Ukrainian drones as Moscow, Kyiv escalate strikes
item.summary: Russia is reporting that it has shot down hundreds of Ukrainian drones in a massive overnight attack across its regions and Crimea

item.title: Israeli judge closes case of Palestinian teen's death in prison despite evidence of starvation
item.summary: A newly unsealed sentence from a court ruling reveals that an Israeli judge acknowledged that a Palestinian teen had been starved in Israeli prison but stopped an investigation into the case

item.title: Two British men detained in a suspected antisemitic hate crime are released on bail
item.summary: British police say two men arrested in connection with an arson attack that destroyed four ambulances owned by a Jewish charity have been released on bail as authorities continue to investigate the suspected antisemitic hate crime

item.title: UK police arrest 2 men over arson attack on ambulances belonging to a Jewish charity
item.summary: British police have arrested two men over an arson attack that destroyed four ambulances from a Jewish charity

item.title: Militants in northern Nigeria kill 10 security forces and 1 resident, officials say
item.summary: Authorities in northern Nigeria say armed militants ambushed security forces who were responding to a distress call in the northwestern state of Kebbi, fatally shooting nine soldiers, a police officer and one resident

item.title: Italy's tourism minister resigns under pressure from Meloni
item.summary: Italy’s tourism minister Daniela Santanchè has resigned in the wake of the defeat of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni government in a referendum on judicial reforms

item.title: Sarah Mullally celebrated as the Church of England's first female leader, in photos
